ACADEMIC & CO-CURRICULAR EXCELLENCE

Go further.

with you.

Silicon Achievers’ Club recognises academic merit and co-curricular achievements, encouraging students to pursue higher professional goals.

Through faculty mentorship, hands-on learning, technical competitions, and peer tutoring, the club creates opportunities to learn, lead, and contribute to the university community.

Growth is the shared purpose.

01
◈

Guidance with purpose.

Faculty monitor progress, provide academic support, and mentor students in innovation, coding, competitive recruitment, higher studies, and examinations such as GATE and CAT.

02
↗

Ideas into action.

Members organise technical events, workshops, lecture series, hackathons, ideathons, and coding competitions that strengthen the culture of learning on campus.

03
◎

Knowledge, passed on.

Peer tutoring, evening tutorials, study materials, model questions, and informative or research articles help junior students and the wider academic community.

04
✦

Achievement, recognised.

Members receive a golden ID-card band, induction recognition, and access to two additional library books. Other support and reimbursements depend on the university’s budget provisions.

MEMBERSHIP & SELECTION

Merit. Commitment. Character.

Membership requires a minimum CGPA of 8.50. The guidelines cover B.Tech. students in semesters 3–7 and third-semester MCA, M.Sc., and M.Tech students. Academic standing, attendance, cleared back papers, good conduct, co-curricular achievements, and a positive attitude to learning are considered.

01

Apply

Respond to the university notification and submit the application and supporting documents to your Faculty Advisor.

Step 01 · Submission
02

Review

The department verifies applications and conducts scrutiny and personal interviews through a three-member senior-faculty committee.

Step 02 · Scrutiny
03

Induction

The university compiles and notifies selected members for the academic session.

Step 03 · Recognition
